xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4451: Approved PRs that turn conflicting never get CI, so conflict repair never fires; blocked agents aren't re-woken when their blockers merge

plan.title: Approved PRs that turn conflicting never get CI, so conflict repair never fires; blocked agents aren't re-woken when their blockers merge
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-4384's conflict-repair gate requires green CI and a passed CI test job at the head, but GitHub runs no pull_request CI on a CONFLICTING PR, so an approved PR that turns conflicting is never repaired (PR #4440 idled ~19 h with no test check). Separately, an agent that parks waiting on sibling issues has no structured way to say so, and nothing wakes it when they merge (PAN-4437).
narratives.Proposal: Waive CI evidence in evaluateConflictRepairGate when the forge says mergeable:false (red checks still disqualify; the merge gate is unchanged). Add pan task block <issue> <item> --on <ref>..., which journals blocked.declared, and a 120 s dashboard blocker-wake patrol that sends the work agent one wake message (journaled as blocked.woken) when every blocker of a still-blocked item has merged. Document both in PIPELINE-GATES.md and MERGE-WORKFLOW.md and tell work agents to declare blockers.
narratives.NonGoals:
- A blocker closed without a merge never wakes the agent
- No escalation timer for a declaration that never resolves
- No GitLab MR refs (#N on GitLab projects, MR URLs); GitLab issue IDs work through getPrFacts
- Conflicting PRs with red checks at the head stay on the CI-failure feedback path
- Conflicting PRs whose approval does not stand at the head are not repaired
- No change to evaluateIssueMergeGate, evaluateMergeReadiness, pr-facts.ts, the auto-merge scheduler or the review pipeline
- No dashboard UI for blocker declarations
- No 'cleared' journal type; pan task unblock writes no journal entry
- No new top-level pan verb

autoDecisions.summary: Waive all CI evidence (pending/none checks, missing or skipped test job) at a conflicting head; keep red checks disqualifying.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue accepts 'no result at all when the PR is conflicting'; GitHub cannot run pull_request CI without a merge ref; the unchanged merge gate re-checks CI on the repaired head, so nothing merges untested.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not read 'last green test result on an earlier head' from the forge.
autoDecisions.rationale: The no-result case already covers it, and an extra read costs GitHub quota with no safety gain.

autoDecisions.summary: Declare blockers with pan task block <issue> <item> --on <ref>... instead of a new verb.
autoDecisions.rationale: Item-level blocking already exists; no new skill, slash-command manifest or src/cli/index.ts growth.

autoDecisions.summary: A declaration is live while the item is still 'blocked' in the continue file and no blocked.woken names it.
autoDecisions.rationale: unblock/done/cancel end a declaration with no extra journal type, and a moved-on agent never gets a stale wake.

autoDecisions.summary: Blocker-wake patrol runs every 120 s in the dashboard with the conflict-repair host skips and kill switch OVERDECK_DISABLE_BLOCKER_WAKE.
autoDecisions.rationale: Waking a minute late is harmless and halves forge reads; the dashboard process owns prompt delivery and the feedback-target ladder.

autoDecisions.summary: Delivery reuses resolveIssueFeedbackTarget + messageAgent with a dedup key; unreachable raises Needs-you once.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same ladder conflict repair uses, so a parked or exited agent is resumed.

metadata.sizeJustification: 20 files, but the projected-surface lint counts each top-level doc file as its own subsystem (docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md, docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md, roles/work.md, sync-sources/skills), giving 7; code changes stay in src/lib/cloister, src/cli/commands and src/dashboard/server. The docs and role-prompt edits describe the code change and must ship with it.

items.title: Waive CI evidence at a conflicting head in evaluateConflictRepairGate

expected_outputs: merge-gate-conflict-repair.test.ts reports every test green including the pending/none, red, waived test job and PR #4440 cases

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 in .pan/drafts/PAN-4451.md. In src/lib/cloister/merge-gate.ts evaluateConflictRepairGate: drop the checks !== 'green' condition, return conflicting:false with reason 'CI checks failing on PR HEAD <sha>' only when checks === 'red', build asMergeable with checks:'green', and call evaluateMergeReadiness with ciTestsRequired:false. Remove the now-unused local ciTestsRequired in that function only and update its JSDoc. Do not edit pr-facts.ts. Update merge-gate-conflict-repair.test.ts exactly as WI-1 lists.

items.title: Given an approved-at-head PR with mergeable:false and checks 'pending' or 'none', evaluateConflictRepairGate returns conflicting:true
Given mergeable:false, checks 'green', testJobSucceeded:false and ciTestsRequired true (the PR #4440 shape), evaluateConflictRepairGate returns conflicting:true
Given mergeable:false and checks 'red', evaluateConflictRepairGate returns conflicting:false with a reason that contains 'CI checks failing on PR HEAD'
Draft, changes-requested, approval-not-at-head and failed-required-UAT cases still return conflicting:false, and git diff origin/main -- src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts shows no change

expected_outputs: blocker-wake.test.ts reports every WI-5 case green
lint completes without errors, including lint:circular
metadata.parallelSafeReason: Two new files only; no existing module is edited, so it cannot collide with sibling items.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-5. Create src/lib/cloister/blocker-wake.ts mirroring conflict-repair.ts: BLOCKER_WAKE_INTERVAL_MS = 120000, injectable BlockerWakeDeps, pendingDeclarations, buildBlockerWakePrompt with the exact WI-5 text, tickBlockerWake. Apply the live-declaration rule (newest declared per item, item still 'blocked' in the continue file, no blocked.woken naming its at), memoize merged refs, batch resolved declarations into one delivery, journal one blocked.woken per declaration with outcome delivered or unreachable, raise Needs-you once when unreachable, never throw. Add blocker-wake.test.ts with every WI-5 case.

items.title: Given a live declaration whose blockers all report merged, tickBlockerWake sends one message and appends blocked.woken with outcome 'delivered' and declaredAt equal to the declaration's at; a second tick sends nothing
Given one unmerged blocker, or an item whose continue-file status is no longer 'blocked', tickBlockerWake sends nothing and appends nothing
Given two items resolved in the same tick, tickBlockerWake sends one message that contains both item ids and appends two blocked.woken entries
When the target is needs-you or delivery throws, tickBlockerWake raises Needs-you once, records blocked.woken with outcome 'unreachable', and the next tick sends nothing
When isMerged throws for one ref, tickBlockerWake logs it and returns without throwing, and a ref seen merged is not read again on the next tick
Host the blocker-wake patrol in the dashboard process

expected_outputs: blocker-wake-patrol.test.ts reports every test green under fake timers

items.title: When the fake clock advances BLOCKER_WAKE_INTERVAL_MS, the patrol runs the injected tick exactly once
startBlockerWakePatrol returns false when OVERDECK_DISABLE_BLOCKER_WAKE=1 or on a peer dashboard, and a frozen Deacon or an overlapping tick skips the tick

When the dashboard boots, main.ts starts the blocker-wake patrol right after the conflict-repair patrol and logs '[overdeck] Blocker-wake patrol started'; shutdown calls stopBlockerWakePatrol beside stopConflictRepairPatrol
